research_question: Can causal pre-09:35 tick-trade flow condition broad-PIT opening shocks into a tradable 10-15 minute edge?

data_contract.universe: quarterly PIT market-cap top500 intersected with daily PIT eligibility and ADV20 >= 10m; source ticker-days pass the causal broad opening-event screen; old/manual 62 unused
data_contract.tick_source: Polygon /v3/trades/{ticker}, 09:25 inclusive to 09:40 exclusive ET, keyed by SIP arrival timestamp
data_contract.signal_clock: only trades with sip_timestamp in [09:30:00,09:35:00) ET; tick-rule warmup may use [09:25:00,09:30:00)
data_contract.execution: exact adjusted 09:40 five-minute bar open; 10m exits at 09:50 and 15m exits at 09:55; missing scheduled bar uses first same-session five-minute open without changing membership
data_contract.locked_validation: 2022-01-01 through 2022-12-30; open only for the highest-ranked development passer
data_contract.quotes: not available under current Polygon entitlement; no spread, NBBO depth, or auction-imbalance claim

common_filters.trade_signing: causal tick rule with last nonzero sign carried forward; unresolved initial trades sign zero

hypotheses.rule: flow_imbalance times first5 direction >= 0.15; trade in first5 direction
flow_imbalance times first5 direction <= -0.15; trade opposite first5 direction
early imbalance times first5 direction >= 0.15 and late imbalance times direction <= -0.20; trade opposite first5 direction
top-20%-trade-dollar imbalance times first5 direction >= 0.20 and large-trade dollar share >= 0.70; trade in first5 direction
TRF share >= 0.15, lit imbalance times direction >= 0.15, and TRF imbalance times direction <= -0.15; trade opposite first5 direction

portfolio.selection: rank each side by abs(first5 return) times frozen microstructure strength times sqrt(capped rvol930)
portfolio.book_requirement: exactly 3 longs and 3 shorts; otherwise no trade that day
portfolio.sic_cap: maximum one ticker per SIC per side
portfolio.weights: equal 1/6 absolute NAV per name, 0.5x long plus 0.5x short

development_gate.winner: highest base-cost Sharpe, then CAGR, among passers

multiple_testing_policy: Exactly five frozen rows. No threshold, feature, horizon, weighting, name-count, or direction changes after performance is observed.
production_policy: No result from this search is a production PASS; a validation pass only continues to execution and concentration audit.
